show.title: Soulection Radio Show #150 w/ SOSUPERSAM
show.content:
Talented & vibrant woman SOSUPERSAM finally came through the studio. 

<!--more-->
It's been a long time coming and we're happy that you finally get a feel for who she is musically and as a person. Wasn't quite sure what she was gonna play for us, but she showed a great diversity and really brought us back to a place that was very much needed towards the end of her set. She's even cooler as a person. Being humble and driven will always get you far. Joe Kay really brought out a diverse selection of music. 


Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #151 w/ Mr. Choc (Beat Junkies)
show.content:
For this week's special guest if you want to talk about pioneers in the game [Mr. Choc](https://twitter.com/MrChocFan4) is one of them. 

<!--more-->

One of our favorite DJ's who's talent and accomplishments are not to be overlooked. 
Representing the world famous Beat Junkies crew and Skam Artists, the crew was blessed to have this man come by Kbeach and hit us with a set and great interview session. 
The thing we admire the most about Choc is that he has his ears close to the new generation of music and understands the culture. 
He threw down a really diverse set and kept us on our toes. 

Joe Kay was on his soulful chop vibe and has really been digging back into the classic neo-soul/boombap sound. 
Make sure you really pay attention to the interview at the end. 
Some great insight on commercial radio on the west coast as well as opportunities for upcoming DJ's. 



Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #153 w/ Dream Koala
show.content:
Joe Kay kicked things off with heavy, heavy vibes from many brand new/unheard artists and collectives. 
<!--more-->

The selection in here was really well thought out and analyzed properly so take notes.

Shouts to Geode and the Chord Marauders who sent over their forthcoming compilation which is simply amazing. Pay attention to these guys, trust. Also look out for Sunni Colòn & Jarreau Vandal. These two artists will be breakthrough artists on Soulection in 2014; guaranteed. We had special guest Dream Koala stop by who is visiting LA for his 1st time all the way from Berlin (current residence but originally from Paris). The young 19 year old threw down a DJ set that included bass and uptempo tribal vibes. In fact, his set was very different from his original production. Dream Koala is very talented and we look forward to see and hear what's to come. 

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #158 w/ Kronika
show.content:
Joe Kay & Kronika hold it down with gems randing from unreleased to forthcoming material, plus forgotten classics. 

<!--more-->
Here is our last the last show of 2013 and ending it with a BANG. 

Every week just keeps getting better and better for us. The music, the accomplishments, and ideas just keep rising. 

This week was supposed to be a ladies edition of Soulection Radio w/ Sasha Marie, Eden, and Kronika but Sasha and Eden both couldn't make it out this time along. 

We'll catch you in 2014 and thank you again for your support. We appreciate you.


Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #169
show.content:
Plenty of new music stacked ready to share with you.
<!--more-->

It felt good to be back after being away from the studio for 4 weeks. We've been traveling for the past month spreading The Sound of Tomorrow at SXSW, WMC, and now Asia. The pros of being away for so long meant that Joe stacked up on plenty of music for the past month which makes up for the lost time, trust. There is too much to say and talk about but shout out to all of the amazing people who came out to our shows to see and connect with us. We are very grateful!

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #171
show.content:
Joe Kay returned with an immense amount and plenty of new ideas/inspiration after Coachella Weekend 1. 

<!--more-->

There are so many new gems in here. We also recently discovered this new platform/label out of Sydney called: [@flowfi](https://soundcloud.com/flowfi) (Accidentally spelled them out wrong on the show as F-L-O), but these guys are coming with HEAT. Make sure you pay attention to them. If you feel this whole session please share. Lets keep educating people with real music. Catch you next week at the same time.

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #172 w/ Rhettmatic (Beat Junkies)
show.content:
Rhettmatic of the legendary beat Junkies Crew graces us with a 50 minute set + an in depth interview. 

<!--more-->

Rhett is definitely one of the most humble guests we've had on here and is more connected than anyone really knows. Do yourself a favor and get mentally prepared to learn a lot. It's much more than just music. Shouts to Rhettmatic, Mr. Choc, J. Rocc, and the rest of the Beat Junkies crew. Also, big big up to Free The Robots for coming through the studio and vibing with us. Much love to you & the whole Crosby crew. Stay tuned for much more to come. Enjoy.

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.
